column1: # THE CORPUS CELL SOURCE OF TRUTH
# One row per corpus cell. This file is the SINGLE declarative source for which
# model releases the fork is tested against AND what each one depends on.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# From PR #85 (2026-05-28) to 2026-08-14 the corpus was FROZEN at 5 cells, and
# the cell list quietly accumulated SEVEN independent hand-maintained copies:
# scripts/refresh-test-corpus.sh PROJECTS, scripts/legacy-vs-fork/cells.txt,
# D11CorpusRegressionTest.ALL_CELLS (+ its three version maps),
# StructuralBaselineDumper.EXPECTED_CELLS, StructuralBaselinesTest's cell count,
# CorpusWalker.TRANSITIVE_DEP_CELL_DIRS and CorpusDiagnosticGateTest.CORPORA /
# CELL_ROOTS. Nothing kept them in step, because nothing ever changed.
# The 2026-08-14 band expansion broke that assumption and exposed the cost. The
# worst instance: CorpusDiagnosticGateTest loaded each corpus's OWN tree via a
# DIRECTORY GLOB (so a new cell auto-loaded) while hardcoding the transitive
# CLOSURE per version (so the new cell's dependencies did NOT load). cdm 6.21.0
# came in without rune-fpml 2.1.1 and drr 7.3.0 without cdm 6.21.0, yielding
# ENUM_NOT_FOUND=1143 / SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND=143 / TYPE_ERROR=398 that looked like
# engine defects and were nothing of the kind. A half-dynamic list is worse than
# a static one: it fails silently and blames the engine.
# FORMAT
# Whitespace-separated columns; no field contains a space; '-' means empty.
# Blank lines and #-comments ignored. Derived values are NOT stored: the repo is
# fixed per corpus, the git tag equals the version, and the on-disk directory is
# always <corpus>/<corpus>-<version>.
#   corpus     cdm | drr | iso20022 | rune-fpml | chaos (AUTHORED - committed, not cloned)
#   version    release version == the upstream git tag
#   state      active  = materialised on disk and gated
#              planned = in the 9.83.0 band, not yet materialised
#   role       catalogue  = a tested cell with its own goldens
#              resolution = loaded ONLY as another cell's dependency closure,
#                           never byte-compared, excluded from the catalogue
#                           census (CorpusWalker.TRANSITIVE_DEP_CELL_DIRS)
#   dsl        the cell's own <rosetta.dsl.version>. Meaningful for catalogue
#              rows (all 9.83.0 by definition of this band). For resolution rows
#              it is recorded for reference but carries no gating weight: their
#              .rosetta source is compiled by the DEPENDENT cell's 9.83.0
#              toolchain, so an older pin here is expected and harmless.
#   declared   what the cell's own pom.xml pins as its dependencies
#   resolved   what we actually load. Differs from `declared` ONLY where we do
#              not carry the exact version and substitute the nearest one. Every
#              such substitution is an approximation and is visible HERE rather
#              than buried in a Java map.
# THE BAND IS COMPLETE, NOT A SAMPLE: established by scanning all 426 stable tags
# across CDM majors 5-8, DRR majors 5-8, ISO majors 1-2 and rune-fpml majors 1-3
# (zero unreadable). Exactly 25 UPSTREAM releases pin 9.83.0 (the vendored band;
# the AUTHORED chaos cell below is cell 26 - the v3.2 chaos-gate charter's own
# corpus, COMMITTED in-repo and materialised by copy from scripts/chaos-expander,
# never cloned - outside that tag census by construction), each band contiguous with an observed
# 9.78.0 boundary below and 9.84.0 above. A windowed scan would NOT have been
# sufficient - the pins are not monotonic (ISO 1.41.0 is on 10.0.0 while the
# LATER 1.42.0 is back on 9.85.1). CDM 7.x is absent because it moved to
# rune-dsl 10.x (7.0.0 on 10.2.2, 7.1.0 on 10.3.0), so CDM tops out at 6.23.0.
# corpus     version  state    role        dsl      declared                    resolved

# Resolution-only cells. Present so a dependent cell's workspace resolves against
# the version it actually pins. Never byte-compared and never counted in the
# catalogue census. Since PR #607 each ACTIVE one also carries goldens generated
# by its OWN toolchain (the dsl column — what the dependent cell's published
# build compiled against, read from the cell's own pom and asserted against the
# build log by refresh-test-corpus.sh --resolution-goldens), read by
# the optimised route's pair gate to compile a band cell's closure against its
# real pins; the frozen-baseline manifest pins them like every other golden.
# THE ONE REMAINING SUBSTITUTION is drr 6.34.1, which declares
# cdm=5.37.0,iso20022=1.37.0 and resolves against cdm=5.38.0,iso20022=1.38.0.
# Only ONE row below is still `planned` — cdm 5.37.0. iso20022 1.37.0 has since
# been materialised and is `active`, so the ISO half COULD already resolve
# exactly (Copilot R9, PR #566).
# It is deliberately not changed here, and the two halves must move TOGETHER:
# drr 6.34.1 is one of the FIVE EXACT RING CELLS, and retargeting only its ISO
# half would resolve it against cdm 5.38.0 + iso 1.37.0 — a pairing that is
# neither the declared pin nor the state the ring is currently EXACT against.
# Materialising cdm 5.37.0 and retiring both halves in one measured step is the
# recorded follow-on.
